data.say: Made one consistency edit: unified the maid/maidservant to the house form maidservant. Left China, Sun Sensei, and Hodoji alone on purpose: China in p8 is the country not a misreading of Changshan, Sun Sensei is the cast form despite the historical kana reading, and Hodoji is the style-sheet temple form.
data.summary: Unified maidservant; left ruby-flagged forms that are established or style-sheet forms unchanged.
